candidate.answerReason: Two distinct planes either intersect or have no common points and are parallel. Distinctness excludes coincidence.

methods.label: Plane-plane position classification
methods.explanation: If two distinct planes do not intersect, they are parallel.
methods.levelReason: This uses only the basic position classification of two distinct planes.
